name: Cold Sweat
tagline: Neon wireframe in the dark, and blocks that lie to you.

facts.note: Known for its fake blocks, placed to mislead the player. Best Extreme Demon in the 2020 Geometry Dash Awards.

theme.mood: Cold and clinical. White wireframe geometry receding into black, hard scanlines across everything, chromatic split on the type, and one rainbow prism beam cutting the frame diagonally.

voice.why:
I love Cold Sweat. The idea behind the level being a semi memory demon is very interesting and cool, and I love the theming — it kind of reminds me of a prism. The song, “Shiver” by False Noise, I think brings this to the next level. I really haven't heard many songs like it, and it's very unique.

This level also holds a special place because of the people I used to watch play it. When it was first verified and showcased, I fell in love instantly. When Doggie played it and made a video about it, it made me love it even more, especially after his devastating death at 98. I don't even know what else to say here — I think it's nothing short of amazing.
